subject: Secure Ingest & Edge Handshake for ShadowRidge Private Deployment
messages:
From: Alex Cheng <alex.cheng@shadowridge.com>
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
Cc: IT Onboarding <it-onboarding@shadowridge.com>; legal@shadowridge.com
Date: Sun, 13 Jun 2027 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Private ingest and edge install — kickoff

Hi Vanessa,

Thanks again for the demo last week. We're ready to move forward with a private deployment for shadowed transaction ingest and an on-prem edge collector. High level asks: VPC peering to our production VPC, private endpoint for model inferencing, and a secure on-prem package for our PCI-scope edge.

Can you please share the onboarding next steps, the networking preflight checklist, and who on your side will own the implementation handoff? We have our networking inventory ready to share.

—Alex Cheng
IT Lead, ShadowRidge Financial
Attachments: shadowridge_network_inventory.xlsx (spreadsheet, 2.4 MB)

From: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
To: Alex Cheng <alex.cheng@shadowridge.com>
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.com; priyom_das@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 09:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private ingest and edge install — kickoff

Alex — thanks for the clear summary and the inventory. Welcome — excited to get this running.

Quick intro of owners:
- Monica Patel (Customer Success) will lead the implementation plan and onboarding milestones.
- Rishi Malhotra (Infra Eng) will run the networking reviews and on-prem packaging guidance.
- Priyom Das (Solutions / AE) will align procurement, SOW, and reserved capacity options.

Proposed immediate next steps (can do a 30–45m kickoff this week):
1) Network preflight review: we review your inventory, confirm CIDR allocations, NAT/bastion requirements, and firewall rules for the private endpoint.
2) On‑prem package checklist: hardware sizing, OS/container baseline, HSM/KMS integration points.
3) Scheduling: pilot window + two-week staging plan + production cutover window.

Action for you: please drop the full network diagram (visio or pdf) and indicate a preferred 1-hour window for kickoff. I attached our preflight checklist draft for your review.

Attachments: redwood_vpc_preflight_checklist.md (text)

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
phone: (415) 555-0192

From: monica_patel@redwood.com
To: Alex Cheng <alex.cheng@shadowridge.com>; vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 10:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private ingest and edge install — kickoff

Alex — looping in the CS plan here.

A few notes from a success/ops perspective:
- We'll operate the initial pilot under our Dedicated model with a 2-week staging period. That lets us validate throughput and KV cache behavior against your ingest profile.
- Please confirm retention/security requirements (S3 lifecycle, audit log retention, and if you need SOC2 evidence within the onboarding window).

For the pilot we typically request:
- A staging VPC with peering to Redwood (or cross-account VPC peering)
- A dedicated private endpoint URL (we'll provision once peering is active)
- A point person for runbook signoff (ops lead)

Open items for the kickoff: which environment will host the edge collector (on-prem VM vs. appliance)? That affects our packaging.

Thanks — Monica Patel
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference

From: priyom_das@redwood.com
To: Alex Cheng <alex.cheng@shadowridge.com>; vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com; monica_patel@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 14:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private ingest and edge install — kickoff

Alex — quick commercial note from my side:
- I have SR-2027-052 in our pipeline for the Dedicated+Onprem package. We can include a 30-day pilot credit and put the Reserved pool on a 3-month evaluation commitment (we'll finalize in the SOW).
- For procurement: please confirm billing entity and whether we should route SOW to legal@shadowridge.com (cc'd on original).

I'll open a Draft SOW and share a DocuSign link prior to the kickoff so legal can triage any terms while we do the technical runbook.

—Priyom Das
Solutions Executive | Redwood Inference

From: Alex Cheng <alex.cheng@shadowridge.com>

All — thanks. Quick answers:
- Edge will be an on‑prem VM (RedHat 8) hosted in our PCI zone. We will not deploy an appliance for this phase.
- Billing entity: ShadowRidge Finance LLC; route SOW to legal@shadowridge.com.
- Attaching the network diagram and the install manifest (contains hostnames, IP ranges, and firewall policy).

Availability for kickoff: Tue 15 Jun 2027, 15:00–16:00 PDT or Wed 16 Jun, 09:00–10:00 PDT. Prefer Tue if you can.
